assumptions: Decided 2026-09-14 (ADR 0009): docs-only, tests-only and config/data-only runs are all abstentions (exit 3). Under --post-comment the abstain path also upserts the sticky with the ✅ 'nothing to test: no source files changed' headline, so an earlier ⚠️ sticky cannot linger. The #761 heuristic-only no-coverage abstention keeps its own headline.
Headline nouns are pluralised (1 file / 2 files, 1 changed file) rather than always 'files'.
Case A renders its headline only when no unit was coverage-matched. Matched units plus non-coverable ones render the plain 'no test-coverage gaps' headline.

coverageStatus is unchanged, so an all-A run is still 'unavailable' in the json status field and still abstains when it has heuristic-only findings (#761). Only the no-findings headline and notice change.
The B headline lists the report's instrumented trees, with '.' for a report rooted at the repo.
The text surface keeps the coverage notice in its footer and adds none to the body, so it appears once there too.
